title: [DOC-5] Entra step-up depends on `acr`/`amr` values Entra is not documented to emit
description: Review finding DOC-5: Entra step-up depends on `acr`/`amr` values Entra is not documented to emit (lens DOC). Location: profiles/o365-employer-did.md:530, :551-552, :605 (and gsuite:514, which inherits it). Fix: Microsoft's access-token claims reference describes `acr` as "a `0` or `1`, only present in v1.0 tokens". Its `amr` value table lists pwd, rsa, otp, fed, wia, mfa, ngcmfa, wiaormfa and none, with no "hwk" or "fido". Step-up is expressed through `acrs` (Auth Context IDs, "used to trigger a demand for step-up authentication"). Rewrite the check as follows: a Conditional Access authentication context that requires phishing-resistant authentication strength, verified via `acrs`, with the claims-challenge flow (`xms_cc`). Keep the purview-bridge.md style "verify against current Entra documentation" hedge on the exact names. Full text: notes/review/DOC-verified.md and notes/review/DOC.md.
